scientific_integrity: All universal formulas are derived analytically; finite exhaustive calculations supplement but do not establish the infinite-parameter theorem. Independent proof and priority validation have not been performed; an inaccessible journal revision and possible older equivalent ring-valued formulations remain priority risks.
scientific_limitations: Requires independent uniform coefficients for the constant and each coordinate-linear monomial over Z/mZ. Identifies pairwise zero covariances, all subset-count covariances, and the first two moments of the full root count only. Does not settle complete generating functions, degree stabilization, higher moments, or association.
title: Exact divisor-scale covariance of zeros of random polynomials over finite residue rings
